title: Your CV Needs Real Feedback
selection_rationale: High candidate pain, likely to stop the scroll.
Concrete enough to feel immediately useful.
Creates an open loop that earns the next few seconds.

heygen_settings.captions: no on-screen text in the rendered video; captions can be platform-native after upload
heygen_settings.rendering: scene-by-scene HeyGen generation, then stitch in Canva or CapCut

spoken_script: Have you applied to dozens of jobs but only got a couple of interviews? I will show you how to gather meaningful feedback on your CV. First: CVs reviewed by industry professionals often stand out more. Second: Targeted feedback can highlight overlooked strengths. Third: Real-world feedback helps align CVs with employer expectations. The rule is simple: Ask professionals in your field for targeted CV advice. Get tailored feedback at internwise.co.uk

production_notes: Open with direct eye contact and no intro logo.
Generate each scene as a separate HeyGen clip because single shots are capped at 15 seconds.
Use light background music behind the voice and keep it low enough that speech stays clear.
Do not add on-screen text to the video.
Do not say 'link in bio' in the video. Put it only in IG/TikTok captions if needed.
No em dashes in captions or overlays.
